correctness.rationale: Correct Steiner normalization follows from Joós--Lángi Corollary 1. For uniform Boolean columns, normalized Gram matrix has mean \(M=(I+\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T})/4\); its inverse and determinant are explicit. \(U=\xi^{\mathsf T}M^{-1}\xi=4R(k+1-R)/(k+1)\), with \(R\sim\operatorname{Bin}(k,1/2)\), has exact \(\mathbb EU=k\), \(\operatorname{Var}(U)=2k/(k+1)\), \(\mathbb EU^2=k(k^2+k+2)/(k+1)\). First-order delta method gives variance \(k/(2\cdot4^k)\); second-order determinant Taylor and bounded concentration give relative coefficient \(-k^3/[4(k+1)d]\) and \(O_k(d^{-2})\) remainder. Verified all fifteen finite direct/compressed intrinsic sums and ten finite-order binomial moment identities from actual package checker path. Fixed k and singular-matrix boundary explicitly handled. The ratio statement follows algebraically from \(k=1\) case.

value.rationale: A canonical, notoriously high-complexity zonotope with \(2^d-1\) nonzero Boolean generators has a tractable, nontrivial full family of fixed-index Euclidean intrinsic-volume asymptotics. The sharp second-order coefficient, nondegenerate Gaussian law for individual generator-parallelotope volumes and normalized ratio \(\sqrt{k+1}/2^{k/2}\) quantify persistent angular alignment and permit metric study without vertex enumeration. These are motivated geometric invariants, not arbitrary finite slices; the already-known generic exact wedge sum is separately credited.
